description: Events that trigger after defeating a dungeon boss, on the way back to town. One random event per return trip.

events.name: Triumphant Merchant Caravan
events.description: A merchant caravan spots your victorious party and offers to trade.

result.message: You purchase 3 potions from the merchants.
The merchants pay top gold for fresh dungeon goods! +50% bonus gold!
Sharing tales of battle inspires your party. +20% bonus XP!

good.message: The merchants flee! You claim 300 gold!

bad.message: They fight back! Your party takes damage.

events.name: Wounded Rival Party
events.description: Another adventuring party lies wounded on the road, defeated by the dungeon you just conquered.

result.message: Grateful, they give you a piece of their best gear!
You scavenge 2 items from their camp.
They teach advanced healing techniques. +20% heal power next run!
You leave them to their fate.

events.name: Ancient Vault Door
events.description: Behind the boss's chamber, a hidden vault door glows with ancient runes.

good.message: The vault opens! Incredible treasures within!

bad.message: A trap explodes! Your party takes heavy damage!

good.message: Wards dissolved! Items and rare materials inside!

bad.message: The wards backlash — your party feels cursed...

result.message: You pocket some scattered coins nearby.

events.name: Mysterious Traveler
events.description: A cloaked figure waits at the dungeon exit. 'I see you survived. I can offer you... an exchange.'

result.message: One party member gains +2 to a random stat permanently!
Ancient knowledge floods your minds. +50% bonus XP!
The traveler draws your blood... and produces a magnificent item.
'Perhaps next time.' The figure vanishes.

events.name: Collapsing Dungeon
events.description: The dungeon begins to shake! The boss's death has destabilized the structure!

bad.message: Falling debris hits the party hard!

good.message: You find a hidden treasure room in the collapse!

bad.message: Nothing valuable, and you take some hits.

result.message: A magical barrier shields the party. You find an item in the rubble.

events.name: Fork in the Return Path
events.description: Two paths lead back to town. The main road... or a shortcut through the Whispering Woods.

result.message: A peaceful walk back to town.

good.message: You discover a hidden herb garden! 5 free potions!

bad.message: Ambushed by forest creatures! Minor injuries.

result.message: A good night's rest. Party fully restored!

events.name: Loot Goblin
events.description: A cackling goblin darts past carrying a sack overflowing with treasure!

good.message: Caught it! 500 gold and 2 items from the sack!

bad.message: It escapes into a tiny tunnel. Gone.
The goblin avoids the trap entirely.

result.message: It drops a single coin as it flees. Sad.

events.name: The Grateful Spirit
events.description: The spirit of someone the boss had imprisoned appears, freed by your victory.

result.message: Divine energy flows into a party member. +3 to a random stat!
The spirit reveals a hidden cache. 150 gold and crafting materials!

choices.text: Ask for knowledge of the next dungeon

result.message: The spirit reveals weaknesses. +10% damage next dungeon run!
The spirit thanks you with a surge of spiritual energy. +30% bonus XP!
